clue.text: Speculative but flawed consultation from which TUC's withdrawn

indicators.note: flawed says the letters of the long word are faulty and must be rearranged
withdrawn says the letters of the union body's name are taken out of the pool first

parts.note: TUC is the Trades Union Congress, the British federation of trade unions; with its S, the letters T, U, C, S

explanation.surface: A union-free consultation is dismissed as speculative and flawed.
explanation.walkthrough: Take T, U, C and S out of CONSULTATION ('withdrawn'); 'flawed' rearranges the eight letters left, ONLATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something hypothetical, existing as an idea rather than in fact.

clue.text: Almost snatch and grab sticky jelly

explanation.definitionFit: Napalm is a jellied petrol used in incendiary bombs.

clue.text: Recent changes in gym are a sham

clue.text: Tailless 12 revolves after 6 and takes a bow!

indicators.note: after puts the turned big-cat word behind the numeral

parts.note: the Roman numeral for six

tailless says the last letter of 12's answer is dropped

parts.note: the answer to 12 across, big cats

explanation.surface: A performer bows after a show involving circling big cats.
explanation.walkthrough: The '!' flags a playful definition: an instrument, not a performer, takes the bow. 'Tailless' and 'revolves' turn the big cats into OLIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A violinist plays with a bow, so the instrument is the thing that takes one.

clue.text: Aussie trucks have some minute scratches

clue.text: England has three such superstars

clue.text: Clandestinely unclad, causing chaos with a vengeance
